machine: CPU-only torch; no model trained, no new generation run
test_set: IN-ABS test[:100], full pipeline, vs published IN-ABS summary
outcome_definition: present = Lawyer summary contains a sentence matched by current section_detector.is_disposition; recall = mean token recall of reference disposition sentences over docs whose reference has one
key_finding: Under one consistent detector, zero-shot presence/recall exceed the fine-tune because zero-shot copies orders verbatim while e3 compresses and drops them; the data fix routes orders to judgement to address this; a corrected retrain is required to confirm.
